title: Borges Finds the Ending
role: Main plot · Discovery · Establishes the temporal contradiction

believed.borges: The outline is evidence of something, though he cannot yet say of what.
believed.leonardo: A finished ending is a gift; waiting for the events would waste it.
believed.agnolo: An outline is a forecast. Producing from it books a future cost against an unlived past.

starting_positions.borges: Has found the outline and wants to establish what it actually is.
starting_positions.leonardo: Wants to produce the outlined ending immediately.
starting_positions.agnolo: Wants to know whether an outline counts as a completed deliverable.

trigger: Borges discovers an outline describing Episode 10 before the intervening events have happened.
exit_condition: The room decides whether to produce the outlined ending, or someone names the contradiction aloud: the story has been completed before the events occurred.

variations.start: The outline is unsigned and undated
The outline contains two incompatible endings
The outline is in Borges's own hand and he does not remember writing it
